name: heavy_duty_6mt
source: racing_game-owned heavy-duty 6-speed manual in the class of the large six-speed boxes of high-torque V8 performance cars, an invented design with no resemblance claimed to any product [AS]. First 2.95 (a strong gearbox can use a taller first), direct fourth (1.00, no countershaft loss), overdrive fifth 0.78 and sixth 0.60; steps 1.42 / 1.42 / 1.46 / 1.28 / 1.30. Mesh efficiency 0.95-0.975, 0.99 in direct fourth (power flows straight through the mainshaft, no gear mesh) [AS]. Large-diameter synchros 100-180 N*m, heavy shafts (input 0.020, output 0.025 kg*m2), slower selector (neutral dwell 0.08 s, dog release 100 N*m, grind after 0.30 s) [AS]. Reverse synchronised (100 N*m). Torque rating 700 N*m is kept in data/gearboxes/gearbox_catalog.json.
